title: Autorig Model Spec
description: Specification schema for Autorig Workbench model configuration (rig.json).

rig.description: Armature construction, skinning rules, and audit parameters.

kind.description: Rig builder type: 'tripo' (reuse joints), 'build' (trace mesh), 'placed' (hand-placed with rules), 'humanoid' (standard biped), 'm2m' (a Mesh2Motion skeleton fitted by steps/m2m_rig.py, see the m2m section), or 'custom' (script).

skeleton.description: Target archetype name (e.g. quadruped, hexapod, winged, serpent, humanoid).

forward.description: Direction vector the model faces in source coordinates before turning to -Y (e.g. [0, -1, 0]).

straighten.description: Straighten sculpt orientation exactly rather than nearest quarter turn.

origin.description: Origin placement: 'feet' (ground at z=0) or 'center' (centred at origin for flyers/swimmers).

builder.description: Path to custom builder script relative to model folder (required when kind is 'custom').

head.description: Head bone name in source armature (tripo).

head_to_snout.description: Extend head bone to the front-most vertex of the face/snout (defaults to true; set false for upright bipeds).

hips.description: Root hips bone name in source armature (tripo).

legs.description: Source bone names designated as legs (tripo).

mirror.description: Bone names to mirror across symmetry plane (tripo).

fold.description: Bones to fold into their parent during re-rooting (tripo).

discard.description: Bones to discard with their subtrees (tripo).

chains.description: Bone chain definitions for build or placed kinds.

jaw.description: Jaw bone placement and binding parameters.

hard_split.description: A lid: everything above a height rides one bone, everything below another (rerig.skin).

parts.description: Two uses of one key: body-part bone ownership rules (placed kind: an object, or a list of {bones, allow, deny}), or, with rigid_parts, the machine parts that ride a bone whole (a list of {bone, at, verts}).

blends.description: Smooth join transition radii between body parts.

rip_welds.description: Seams between parts to rip apart before skinning to prevent tearing.

membranes.description: Wing or fin membrane distance gradient binding rules.

rigid_islands.description: Loose pieces locked 100% to one bone (armour plates, buckles). "auto" or true: every small loose piece to its dominant or nearest bone (the humanoid kind's default; for the other kinds it is off unless set, or unless rigid_armor, armor or accessories is); false or "off": none; a list: the pieces named, by "island" index, "at" (0..1) or "box" (two corners, 0..1).

envelope.description: After bone heat: "root" (the default: no limb weight behind where the limb starts), "full" (the torso to the spine, each limb to a capsule round it; joint_blend and limb_radius tune it), false (plain bone heat).

skinning.description: "bone-heat" (the default: bone heat on the mesh, a voxel copy only when it fails) or "proxy-transfer" (bone heat on a watertight voxel copy, its weights carried back by robust transfer).

proxy_voxel.description: proxy-transfer: the voxel size tried first, a fraction of the longest side (then 0.016, 0.022, 0.012, 0.03).

transfer_distance.description: proxy-transfer: how far a vertex may be from the voxel copy's surface and still copy its weights, a fraction of the longest side (default 2.5 voxels).

transfer_angle.description: proxy-transfer: the most the normals may disagree, in degrees, either way round (default 30).

smooth.description: Weight smoothing passes (run before the barrier).

barrier.description: Air-gap barriers between limbs (default true); the standing-body rules in it run for bipeds only.

flank_barrier.description: Front limbs off the rump, hind limbs off the chest (quadrupeds and multi-legged bodies).

radial_barrier.description: Each leg of a multi-legged body kept to its own sector around the body.

crotch_barrier.description: Width of the seam fade between the legs, in model units (default 3% of the model's size).

centerline_armor.description: Small loose pieces across the pelvis ride the hips; on a biped, the crotch seam blends to the hips.

auto_heal.description: The closing smoothing of steep weight steps; never touches deliberate cuts.

heal_validate.description: Trial the healer against sampled bends and twists; roll back if deformation worsens. Default true.

audit_motion_ranges.description: Bone name to bend/twist angle lists in degrees; defaults are bend 40, twist 60.

audit_clip_bends.description: Bone name to degrees: how far the rig's clips turn each bone, with headroom (steps/m2m_rig.py writes it). The audit bends each bone this far instead of 40, and no further in the combined pose; 0-40.

rigid_island_max_share.description: Largest automatic rigid piece, as a share of all vertices (default 0.1).

rigid_island_max_extent.description: Largest automatic rigid piece, as a share of the model's longest side (default 0.25): a garment longer than this still bends.

audit.description: Audit check allowances override for this model (requires notes['rig.audit']).

m2m.description: For kind 'm2m' (steps/m2m_rig.py): which Mesh2Motion skeleton, where its joints are, and what was baked.

joints.description: Every bone's head by Mesh2Motion's bone name, [x, y, z] in metres on the body as modelled (the rigged files' own coordinates, before a template rest straightens a snake or a fish), in the axes named by `axes`. The API's skeleton and the Mesh2Motion bridge use this shape; m2m_rig.py --joints takes it back to re-fit from edited joints.

axes.description: The joints' axes: 'gltf' (Y up, facing +Z, as Mesh2Motion and three.js see it; the default) or 'blender' (Z up, facing -Y).

rest.description: The exported rest pose: the template's (snakes and fish are straightened along its line) or the body as modelled.

clips.description: The Mesh2Motion clips baked, by their own names.

skin.description: The skinning method: autorig (bone heat on a voxel copy) or m2m (Mesh2Motion's own, core/m2m_skin.py).

naming.description: Bone names written: Mesh2Motion's own, or Mixamo's (human only).

target.description: FBX axes: Unity's (roots at rotation 0, scale 1) or Blender's exporter's.

z.description: Z height coordinates (0..1 of model height).

budget.description: Engine decimation triangle budget target. Null keeps full resolution.

clips.description: Animation clips configuration for procedural generation.

secondary.description: Springs baked into the clips for these chains: tails, ears, antennae, wing membranes (docs/CLIP-MOTION.md).

bones.description: The chain's bones, root first, each the parent of the next.

chain.description: A stem: every chain of that name (tail_1.., ear_1.L.., wing.L_1.L..), each side its own.

clips.description: Only these clips and their variants (default every clip).

card.description: Engine metadata card published with the rigged assets.

notes.description: Explanations and rationale for allowances or non-default options.
